header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This
petition was filed in the year 2020 and lastly fixed on 05.01.2021.
Thereafter, no efforts were made to proceed with the matter. Today, learned
A.A.G filed comments on behalf of respondent No.3, taken on record. In
body: Para No.3, it is stated that in respect of the instant grievance civil suit was filed before the Court of Senior Civil Judge, Umerkot which was dismissed and appeal achieved same fate.

It further reveals that District Judge passed an order dated 16.04.2014 in Human Rights Application No.68/2014 on an application filed by Dr. Ambreen against the C.M.O, Municipal Committee, Umerkot directing the District Administration to shift the wholesale vegetable market from Gulshan-e-Saleem to some other suitable Government land. Whereas, the license holders of the Vegetable and Fruit Market Committee, Umerkot were running their businesses on a rented plot in violation of the terms and conditions of the agreement. Therefore, their licenses were cancelled by the competent authority and the fruit and vegetable market was shifted to plot gifted by respondent No. 5.
Under these circumstances, the instant petition being meritless stands dismissed along with listed application.
